text: On April 5, 2016, the applicant submitted an Official Plan Amendment for the lands municipally known as 1966-2050 Eglinton Avenue East and 50 Thermos Road (the "Subject Lands") to permit a mixed-use development including new public streets and parkland. On September 7, 2021, the applicant submitted a Zoning By-law Amendment for the western portion of the lands at 1966-1980 Eglinton Avenue East. The Subject Lands are located within the Golden Mile Secondary Plan area. On November 24, 2017, the applicant appealed their proposed Official Plan Amendment to the Ontario Land Tribunal (the "OLT") due to Council's failure to make a decision within the statutory timeframe.
